description: This bar chart illustrates the Fleiss Kappa statistic for two sets of data, each representing the agreement between annotators, as a function of ambiguity. The horizontal axis represents the categories of “Ambiguity Std” on the left and “Max Ambiguity” on the right, with labels 0.0, 0.47, 0.82, and 0.94 for the first set and 1, 2, and 3 for the second set, displayed in ascending numerical order. The vertical axis is labeled “Fleiss Kappa” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.88, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. For the “Ambiguity Std” data, there are three bars corresponding to the categories 0.47, 0.82, and 0.94, all colored in a shade of teal, with approximate heights of 0.8, 0.24, and 0.23 respectively. For the “Max Ambiguity” data, there are three bars corresponding to the categories 1, 2, and 3, also colored in a shade of teal, with approximate heights of 0.89, 0.46, and 0.46 respectively. Each bar is labeled with its corresponding Fleiss Kappa value at the top. The bars are not visually emphasized and are arranged in ascending order based on their horizontal axis labels.
